A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ReSpinQuant and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–B. The retained material and added appendix experiments can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantization accuracy, perplexity, latency, calibration-time, and rank-ablation results on LLaMA-family models.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds spectral measurements, additional precision configurations, and C4-calibration comparisons.

M1.justification: The layer-wise rotations, offline weight fusion, SVD-based subspace selection, orthogonalization, and residual correction remain unchanged. The default approximation rank remains 32; the new experiments evaluate the existing method.

E1.justification: Appendix B.3 adds C4 as an alternative calibration corpus. WikiText-2 evaluation and the nine zero-shot tasks remain unchanged; additional precision configurations do not introduce new tasks.

E2.justification: Retained comparisons use the same RTN, GPTQ, QuaRot, SpinQuant, OSTQuant, and FlatQuant baselines. The added appendix comparisons reuse SpinQuant; no comparator is introduced, removed, or substantively revised in corresponding existing experiments.

E3.justification: Appendix B substantially extends evaluation settings with W4A4KV16, W4A8KV8, and W4A8KV16 configurations, a calibration-corpus substitution experiment, and spectral-energy/Frobenius-retention measurements on LLaMA-2 7B under W3A3. These are added experiments; the original main-experiment protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond v1's optimization visualizations and task-performance rank ablation, v2 adds direct spectral concentration and retained-correction measurements (B.1/Table 6), plus calibration-corpus sensitivity across five models (B.3/Table 8). These materially expand the mechanism and robustness analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for the experimental results. The new spectral measurements do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: New Tables 6–8 add spectral, mixed-precision, and C4-calibration outcomes. For example, rank 32 captures 55.77% cumulative energy and retains 73.80% Frobenius magnitude. Separately, Table 1 changes ReSpinQuant's LLaMA-2 13B W4A4 PPL/accuracy from 5.12/65.78 to 5.13/65.82, matching values already present in v1's detailed appendix table. The retained detailed benchmark results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Equations (1)–(11) remain unchanged. Appendix B.1 empirically examines the existing deviation matrix T−I without adding a theorem, proof, or new formal assumption.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims: expressive layer-wise quantization through weight fusion and inexpensive residual approximation, with strong W4A4/W3A3 performance. The additional experiments support these retained contributions.

C2.justification: Appendix B newly interprets results as supporting calibration-corpus robustness and applicability across mixed-precision settings, with smaller gains when SpinQuant approaches full precision. The original limitations concerning model scale, optimization objectives, and specialized kernels remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A is unchanged, including hardware, software, optimization steps, learning rates, clipping, and baseline implementation information. The added experiments specify evaluation conditions but introduce no additional implementation procedures or code/data access information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same. Bibliographic revisions alter metadata, author-list formatting, and displayed URLs without adding or removing cited research.

P1.justification: Appendix B is organized into four subsections, with the existing detailed-results discussion retained in B.4. Other localized edits add acknowledgements and conference information, revise bibliography formatting, and standardize TTIT terminology. The main narrative is largely unchanged.

P2.justification: Three new appendix tables are inserted; v1's detailed Tables 6–7 are retained and relocated as Tables 9–10. Figure 3's caption corrects the displayed submatrix indices from [4:, 4:] to [:4, :4]. Existing graphics and main table structures otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides useful additional evidence for residual compressibility and performance across precision and calibration conditions, while correcting Table 1's inconsistency with the detailed results and Figure 3's caption. These strengthen an otherwise unchanged paper. The calibration-insensitivity interpretation remains only partly supported: the added comparison clearly establishes retained gains over SpinQuant, but offers less support for the broader insensitivity claim.
